column1: # comment: "Version-pinned bridge views onto the YAMATO 2021-08-08 OWL export. Its process/event, role, material-quantity, and quality-value commitments remain distinct, so no identity-strength axiom is emitted."

column6: YAMATO independent_entity is the nearest endurant-facing bridge but carries a role-participation commitment absent from the source category.
YAMATO distinguishes event from stative process; the bridge preserves that distinction rather than collapsing both to one identity.
YAMATO process is stative and therefore a commitment-shifting view, not an equivalent class.
Both categories locate a quality in a value space; YAMATO additionally commits quality_value to a generically-dependent context with exactly one value dimension and bearer.
YAMATO amount_of_matter is the material-portion category matching logic:Quantity; it is not YAMATO's numerical quantity or measurement-value hierarchy.
YAMATO separates role concepts and holders through its Hozo role model; this row names only the nearest role-class bridge.
